create_LogitRelaxedBernoulli: create a LogitRelaxedBernoulli distribution with temperature, probs or logits for reparametrizable sampling in the logit space
create_RelaxedBernoulli: create a RelaxedBernoulli distribution with temperature and probs or logits as a continuous relaxation of Bernoulli with values in (0, 1)
sample_LogitRelaxedBernoulli: sample from LogitRelaxedBernoulli using rsample with reparametrized gradient flow through the concrete distribution
sample_RelaxedBernoulli: sample from RelaxedBernoulli using rsample with reparametrizable samples transformed through sigmoid into (0, 1)
compute_log_prob: compute log probability of a value under LogitRelaxedBernoulli or RelaxedBernoulli distribution given logits and temperature
